description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveCommentDecorator class, which is used to add additional behavior and helper methods around the LeaveComment entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting the creator (employee or user), associating the leave entry, and formatting the creation date/time.

classes.name: LeaveCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing helper methods to manipulate LeaveComment entities, including setting related entities and formatting creation timestamp.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the leave comment, identified by employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the User who created the leave comment, identified by user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveById
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with the comment, identified by leave ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as 'H:i'.
